node.statement: Fix all universal witnesses in the dependency order, choosing the reset-threshold witnesses C_unit, epsilon_unit, delta_unit, a_unit once from lem-maincb-reset-output-typing and using those same witnesses in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger; then fix the single ledger datum W named in the contract and D_* from that ledger. These compatible choices have D_* >= 1, W.c0_cb equal to the enlarged c0, W.K1 >= K_1^0 >= 1, W.e1 <= e_1, and the W.r_reset threshold inequalities required by lem-maincb-reset-output-typing.
